title: Chunk an Array
prompt: A gallery loads items in rows of a fixed size. Write a function that splits the array into groups of the given size, in order. The final group may be smaller if the array does not divide evenly.

explanation.beginner:
Example: chunk([1,2,3,4,5], 2) produces [[1,2],[3,4],[5]]. The result must follow this precise rule: A gallery loads items in rows of a fixed size. Write a function that splits the array into groups of the given size, in order. The final group may be smaller if the array does not divide evenly. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “splits evenly”: input [[1,2,3,4],2] produces [[1,2],[3,4]]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
